shortDescription: Download the official SSC Junior Engineer JE 2026 Paper I and Paper II exam syllabus PDF for Civil, Electrical, Mechanical and Telecom preparation.
content:
The SSC Junior Engineer JE Syllabus 2026 covers Paper-I and Paper-II of the Junior Engineer examination for Civil, Electrical, Mechanical and Telecom engineering disciplines.

Paper-I

  • General Intelligence and Reasoning
  • General Awareness
  • General Engineering: Civil / Electrical / Mechanical as selected by the candidate

Paper-II

Paper-II focuses on the candidate's selected engineering discipline and tests technical knowledge in depth. Candidates should use the official PDF for the complete topic-wise syllabus, scheme, marks, duration and negative-marking instructions.

Download the official Paper I and Paper II syllabus PDF from the Important Links section below.

faqs.question: Where can I download the SSC JE Paper I and Paper II syllabus?
faqs.answer: Open the Download Paper I & II Exam Syllabus link in the Important Links section on this page.

faqs.question: Which subjects are included in SSC JE Paper I?
faqs.answer: Paper I includes General Intelligence and Reasoning, General Awareness and General Engineering for the selected discipline.

faqs.question: Does SSC JE Paper II test technical subjects?
faqs.answer: Yes. Paper II focuses on the candidate's selected engineering discipline.
